P.name: Glory in Death
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Upon taking {{tip|Death|fatal damage}}, '''Sion''' enters {{tip|stasis}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds to {{tip|Zombie state|reanimate}} into a frenzy, restoring {{as|100% of his '''maximum''' health}} but {{tip|health resource|losing}} {{as|{{pp|2 + (19-2)/17*(x-1) for 20}} health}} every {{rutngt|0.25}}, increasing by{{ft|70% of the '''base''' value|{{as|{{pp|2*0.7 + (19*0.7-2*0.7)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|health}}}}per subsequent tick. '''Sion's''' {{as|{{sti|health regeneration}}}} and any {{tip|heal|healing}} (except {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and {{tip|omnivamp}}) he receives during this time is {{tt|0% effective|See notes}}.
P.description3: '''Sion's''' damage to {{tip|structures}} is reduced to 40% under the effects of ''Glory in Death''.

P.name: Death Surge
P.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Sion''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{tt|67%|See notes, this value is currently bugged}}|ms}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over {{fd|2.376}} seconds.

''Once at least one ability has been learned, Death Surge can be cast using any ability key, even for the abilities that haven't been learned yet.''

Q.name: Decimating Smash
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sion''' prepares a strike in the target direction, {{tip|channel|charging}} for up to 2 seconds to increase ''Decimating Smash's'' {{sti|range}} over an area, {{tip|airborne|knock up}} duration, {{tip|stun}} duration, and damage every {{fd|0.25}} seconds, which has up to a maximum '''bonus''' for the '''base''' damage and up to a 200% '''bonus''' for the ''scaling'' damage.
Q.description2: ''Decimating Smash'' can be recast within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards. If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}, ''Decimating Smash'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|2-second}} cooldown.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Sion''' flails his axe in the direction he targeted at the time of cast, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 50% for {{fd|0.25}} seconds. ''Decimating Smash'' deals 165% damage against {{tip|monsters}} and 60% damage against {{tip|minions}}.
Q.description4: If ''Decimating Smash'' was charged for at least 1 second, '''Sion''' instead slams his axe down, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for {{pp|type=channel time|0.5 to 1 for 5|1 to 2|formula=0.5+(0.125 every 0.25 seconds). ''Calculation starts at the first second.''|changedisplay = true}} seconds, and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{pp|type=channel time|1.25 to 2.25 for 5|1 to 2|formula=1.25+(0.25 every 0.25 seconds). ''Calculation starts at the first second.''|changedisplay = true}} seconds.

W.name: Soul Furnace
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Sion''' gains {{sti|health|{{as|4 '''bonus''' health}}}} whenever he kills an {{tt|enemy|see notes for details}}, increased to {{as|15|health}} for large enemies and {{tip|takedown|takedowns}} against enemy {{tip|champions}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sion''' grants himself a {{tip|shield}} that lasts for up to 6 seconds. ''Soul Furnace'' can be recast after 3 seconds while the shield holds, and does so automatically at the end of the duration.
W.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Sion''' consumes the shield to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, capped at 400 against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
W.leveling3: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 140}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}} {{as|(+ 14% of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
W.description4: ''Both of Soul Furnace's casts can be activated during '''Sion's''' other abilities.''

W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Sion''' gains {{sti|health|{{as|4 '''bonus''' health}}}} whenever he kills an {{tt|enemy|see notes for details}}, increased to {{as|15|health}} for large enemies and {{tip|takedown|takedowns}} against enemy {{tip|champions}}.

E.name: Roar of the Slayer
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sion''' bellows a shockwave in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, {{tip|slow|slows}} them for {{fd|2.5}} seconds and inflicts them with {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|25% armor reduction}}}} for 4 seconds.
E.description2: If the target is a {{tip|minion}} or non-epic {{tip|monster}}, they are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds and {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} for up to 1350 units further, though not through terrain, applying ''Roar of the Slayer's'' effects to enemies they pass through as well as briefly granting {{tip|sight}} of the area around their trajectory.

R.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sion''' becomes {{tip|Cc-immune|immune to crowd control}} and {{tip|ghosted}} and, after a {{tt|brief delay|0.05 (Estimated)}}, {{tip|channel|charges}} forward in the direction of the cursor for up to 8 seconds, during which he is able to steer at a slow turn rate while automatically navigating his movement. ''Unstoppable Onslaught'' can be recast after {{tt|{{fd|0.4}}|Estimated}} seconds during the channel.
R.description2: The charge ramps up '''Sion's''' {{tt|{{as|movement speed}}|Post movement speed caps}} at the time of cast by {{as|40 movement speed}} every {{fd|0.1}} seconds, up to {{as|950 '''total''' movement speed}}.
R.description3: At the end of the charge's duration, '''Sion''' {{tip|lunge|leaps}} forward {{tt|300|Can end up being slightly shorter, but not related to to Sion's speed}} units, landing after {{fd|0.55}} seconds and slamming the {{tt|ground|400 radius}} beneath him. '''Sion''' will stop upon {{tt|colliding|150 units in front of Sion for the charge and point blank for the leap}} with an enemy champion or {{tt|terrain|Includes structures, read notes for details on player-generated terrain}} during the charge, ending ''Unstoppable Onslaught'' with a slam. Crashing into terrain {{tip|stun|stuns}} '''Sion''' for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
R.description4: Enemies hit by '''Sion's''' charge are dealt {{as|physical damage}}. The ''base'' damage increases by {{pp|type=channel time|changedisplay=true|key=%|0 to 500/3 for 4|0 to 3|formula=55.55% every 1 second. ''This is capped at 3 seconds.''}} and the ''scaling'' increases by {{pp|type=channel time|changedisplay=true|key=%|0 to 100 for 4|0 to 3|formula=33.33% every 1 second. ''This is capped at 3 seconds.''}}.
R.leveling4: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|150 to 450}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|400 to 1200}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
R.description5: Enemies, including {{tip|turret|turrets}}, hit by the slam are dealt the same damage and are {{tip|slow|slowed}} for 3 seconds. Enemies in a {{tt|smaller radius|350 range, estimated}} are also {{tip|airborne|pulled}} towards '''Sion''' over {{fd|0.5}} seconds and become {{tip|stun|stunned}} after a brief delay for {{pp|type=channel time|label1=seconds|changedisplay=true|0.25 to 1.75|0 to 3 by 1}} seconds.
R.description6: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Sion''' leaps forward, causing him to stop charging and slam the ground beneath him as if ''Unstoppable Onslaught'' had reached the end of its duration.
